units.source_text: 此外，也有太吉郎的父辈或祖辈收集保存下来的东西，

en.t: Besides these, there were also items that Taikichiro's father or grandfather had collected and preserved,

units.source_text: 可是每当举办织锦展览，希望他提供展品时，

en.t: but whenever a brocade exhibition was held and he was asked to lend pieces for display,

units.source_text: 他总是非常冷淡地加以谢绝：

en.t: he would always refuse very coldly:

units.source_text: “遵照祖先的遗志，敝舍所藏，概不外借。”

en.t: "In accordance with our ancestors' wishes, nothing in our family's collection is ever lent outside."
